deliverables.text: A static The Puzzle School website that builds to plain HTML/CSS/JS and can be hosted on GitHub Pages
deliverables.note: Astro static build (npm run build) with .github/workflows/deploy.yml publishing to GitHub Pages. Delivered by earlier cycles, not this one.

deliverables.text: The first two designed pages implemented faithfully to the supplied designs
deliverables.note: home.md and about.md render the supplied designs; covered by the Home - Full Design and About - Full Design scenarios. Delivered by earlier cycles, not this one.

deliverables.text: codeyam-cms integrated so site content can be edited without touching code
deliverables.note: /admin edits content collections with no code change; exercised end-to-end in this cycle's demo. Delivered by earlier cycles; this cycle improved staged-preview fidelity on top of it.

deliverables.text: New pages can be added through the CMS without writing code
deliverables.note: src/pages/[...slug].astro routes any CMS-authored entry; demonstrated by the Page - Created From The CMS scenario. Delivered by earlier cycles, not this one.

deliverables.text: Improvements made to codeyam-cms itself where needed to support static-site authoring
deliverables.note: No change shipped to @codeyam/cms, which is an npm dependency here. Two real defects were diagnosed and written up this cycle - parseEntry has no YAML block-scalar support (content loss on the admin save path), and the editor capture guard mis-scopes seed sentinels - and both were worked around in this repo with follow-up plans queued. The upstream fixes remain owed.
